case.pattern_description: Coordinated multi-card abuse conducted from a specific Samsung SM-G935F mobile device operating behind an anonymous IP proxy. The device connects multiple unrelated cards in rapid succession, generating unauthorized card-not-present purchases designed to evade real-time score thresholds. This activity directly matches the undocumented syndicated device ring pattern established in prior confirmed fraud cases CC-2649, CC-2985, CC-2971, and CC-3035.

evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3467635 scored low on both the fraud model (model_score 0.048, hist_fraud_rate 0.006) and legacy real-time risk score (0.29).
Transaction 3467635 was made online using device D004630, which was new to this account and routed through an anonymous proxy IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS.

Device D004630 belongs to ring 57672119 and was used across 8 distinct cards in the window (including C01996-K2, C10326-K1, C01289-K1, C02975-K1, C13487-K1, C09975-K1, and C08168-K1), appearing as a new device and behind an anonymous proxy for each card.
Device D004630 is linked to four confirmed fraud closed cases (CC-2649, CC-2985, CC-2971, and CC-3035), all of which confirmed unauthorized online purchases under an undocumented pattern.
Holder C04108-K2|441|139 has zero prior transactions, providing no baseline of legitimate activity or established recurring charges.
Billing region 441 in the 7-day window has a hot share of 0.0116 and a lift vs all transactions of 0.56, indicating no localized regional fraud concentration.

evidence.claim: Rule R9: Undocumented patterns: Rule R9: Undocumented patterns. When activity fits none of the known patterns but the evidence shows coordinated or repeated abuse across customers, recommend `CREATE_CASE`, `FILE_REPORT`, and `ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST`, and describe the pattern in your own words. Do not force it into a known category.

Rule R6: Shared origin: Rule R6: Shared origin. When several cards show fraud from the same device profile, the same billing region, or the same recipient email in one window, name the shared element, recommend `CREATE_CASE` and `FILE_REPORT`, and `MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS` for every card that shares it.

case.summary: Post-transaction monitoring flagged transaction 3467635 ($162.35) on card C04108-K2 due to the utilization of device D004630, which belongs to suspicious ring 57672119. Device D004630 (a Samsung Galaxy S7 Edge) appeared as new across eight distinct cards behind an anonymous proxy within a 30-day period and is linked to four prior confirmed fraud cases (CC-2649, CC-2985, CC-2971, and CC-3035). However, the transaction produced very low model (0.048) and risk (0.29) scores, and no cardholder dispute is on file. Consequently, the case verdict remains uncertain with an estimated fraud probability of 0.186, leading to analyst escalation and monitoring of connected cards under rules R6 and R9.
